inference_protocol: Video IDs identify the normalized input clips/views and must never be inferred from event or slot IDs.

FOCUS evidence is valid only for its cited video and time span; it cannot prove whole-video or cross-video absence.
Count physical entities or transitions, not frames, mentions, or duplicate observations of the same event.
The final answer is exactly one ordered numeric interval [start_seconds, end_seconds] with start_seconds < end_seconds.
v1 is the fixed reference segment and v2 is the search video; their clocks are independent.
Match functional step and state transition before refining boundaries; local visual resemblance alone is insufficient.
The final answer is exactly one ordered [start_seconds, end_seconds] interval in v2 local seconds.
